test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 10 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

A group of people. especially traders or pilgrims, travelling together across a desert
solution:
The correct answer is "**Caravan**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given words.
 
• **Procession: **a number of people or vehicles moving forward in an orderly fashion, especially as part of a ceremony.
 
• **Convoy: **a group of ships or vehicles travelling together, typically one accompanied by armed troops, warships, or other vehicles for protection.
 
• **Parade: **a public procession, especially one celebrating a special day or event.
 
• **Caravan: **any large group of people, especially traders or pilgrims, typically with vehicles or animals, travelling together in a single file.
 
• As per the meaning of the given words, "**caravan**" is the one-word substitute for the given group of words.
 
 
• **Example**: *Travelling in **caravans **__for trade and pilgrimage was common on the silk route.*
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is** option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__** 

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given words.
 
• **Procession:**कई लोग या वाहन एक व्यवस्थित तरीके से आगे बढ़ते हैं, खासकर एक समारोह के हिस्से के रूप में।
 
• **Convoy:**एक साथ यात्रा करने वाले जहाजों या वाहनों का एक समूह, आमतौर पर सशस्त्र सैनिकों, युद्धपोतों या सुरक्षा के लिए अन्य वाहनों के साथ।
 
• **Parade:**एक सार्वजनिक जुलूस, विशेष रूप से एक विशेष दिन या घटना का जश्न मनाने वाला।
 
• **Caravan:**लोगों का कोई भी बड़ा समूह, विशेष रूप से व्यापारी या तीर्थयात्री, आमतौर पर वाहनों या जानवरों के साथ, एक ही फ़ाइल में एक साथ यात्रा करते हुए।
 
• As per the meaning of the given words, "**caravan**" is the one-word substitute for the given group of words.
